verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own pages name a lead attorney, Joseph Asir, state that every petition is reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before filing, and describe preparation, review and filing within one accountable team. That rules out an unsupervised form service. However, the site says plainly that LegalOS Inc. is not a law firm and its services are not legal advice, and it frames attorneys as reviewers of AI-assisted preparation rather than as the lawyers who prepare and file as attorney of record. Missing for 10: an explicit attorney-of-record or G-28 representation model, evidence that attorneys (not workflows) prepare and sign the filing, bar or licensure details for the named attorney beyond experience claims, and independent corroboration.
